# Third-party dependencies (vendored)

| Library | Path | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| dr_wav | `dr_wav/dr_wav.h` | WAV I/O |
| nlohmann/json | `nlohmann/json.hpp` | Config parsing (non-DSP path) |
| pffft | `pffft/` | FFT backend behind `stemy::fft` |
| GoogleTest | `googletest/` | Unit tests (v1.14.0 sources) |

These components retain their upstream licenses. STEMY application code remains proprietary.
